verdict_rationale: The production engine trader-timemachine/benchmark_engine.py still contains the uncorrected DSR scaling bug (producing z=-31.32 instead of z=-1.61) and uncentered bootstrap implementation. Audit scripts proved the corrections, but production code was never updated.

deflated_sharpe_ratio.explanation: Production benchmark_engine.py divides annualized numerator by daily standard error, inflating z by sqrt(365.25)

paired_bootstrap_test.explanation: Production paired_block_bootstrap_test computes raw fraction of uncentered replicates <= 0 (0.1220) rather than simulating under H0 (0.1800)

trial_data_empirical_audit.rationale: Historical V1-V3 trials evaluated intraday candles (15m, 1h) on individual tokens with non-overlapping horizons, making cross-sectional daily return correlation empirically impossible to compute from saved records.

walk_forward_evaluation.survivorship_bias_warning: Universe (BTC, ETH, SOL, BNB) was selected with 2026 hindsight; mechanical anti-leakage cannot eliminate macro survivorship bias.

issue_classification.production_dsr_scaling: defective (in benchmark_engine.py; corrected in audit scripts)
issue_classification.production_bootstrap_centering: defective (in benchmark_engine.py; corrected in audit scripts)
issue_classification.production_sharpe_metric: compounded only (arithmetic Sharpe missing in benchmark_engine.py)
issue_classification.m_eff_claim_15_to_25: unresolved / unverified sensitivity assumption (data missing to compute 67x67 correlation matrix)
issue_classification.sigma_trials_0_50_claim: unverified sensitivity assumption (not an empirical measurement)
issue_classification.walk_forward_macro_lookahead: unresolved limitation (4-asset universe suffers from survivorship bias)
